## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive (Energy, Healthcare). Confirmations: sector breadth ≤4/11 and Financials + Industrials both negative; leadership concentration narrow (Top 5: 4/5 Technology) reinforces caution.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +5.39% | 1M: +6.44%) ABOVE TREND, EOG (1W: +5.77% | 1M: +7.80%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare also positive: TMO (1W: +6.44% | 1M: +9.11%) ABOVE TREND, ABBV (1W: +5.73% | 1M: +5.44%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples is marginal vs peers: WMT (1W: +1.92% | 1M: -6.00%) RECOVERY.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Utilities weak: CEG (1W: -13.09% | 1M: -7.86%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary weak: TSLA (1W: -3.15% | 1M: +4.18%) CORRECTION. Materials/Industrials under pressure: FCX (1W: -9.45% | 1M: +4.35%) CORRECTION, ETN (1W: -7.04% | 1M: -13.09%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: PANW (1W: +11.31% | 1M: -2.39%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +13.63%) ABOVE TREND, ACN (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +9.33%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +7.88% | 1M: +13.89%) ABOVE TREND, ISRG (1W: +7.71% | 1M: -4.40%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — narrow tech concentration amid broader weakness.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: ETN (1W: -7.04% | 1M: -13.09%) BELOW TREND, CMCSA (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -6.72%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -13.67%) BELOW TREND, GE (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -16.65%) BELOW TREND, FCX (1W: -9.45% | 1M: +4.35%) CORRECTION — weakness concentrated in Industrials and select Tech/Materials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: PANW (1W: +11.31% | 1M: -2.39%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +13.63%) ABOVE TREND, ACN (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +9.33%) ABOVE TREND; note MAJOR divergence present (≥3 large names with 1W ≠ 1M: PANW, ISRG, GOOGL, LLY, WMT) — treat moves as tactical rather than regime-confirming.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech is under pressure overall: Tech sector 1W: -0.32% with many large names weak; NVDA (1W: -5.90% | 1M: -5.66%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -13.64% | 1M: -6.76%) BELOW TREND, IBM (1W: +7.01% | 1M: +6.00%) ABOVE TREND — mixed internals with narrow leadership.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials showing weakness: JPM (1W: -0.29% | 1M: -2.85%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: +1.89% | 1M: +3.15%) ABOVE TREND but sector-wide 1W negative; breadth and earnings chatter not supporting a risk-on rotation.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare is one of two positive sectors: TMO (1W: +6.44% | 1M: +9.11%) ABOVE TREND, ABBV (1W: +5.73% | 1M: +5.44%) ABOVE TREND, ISRG (1W: +7.71% | 1M: -4.40%) RECOVERY — defensive qualities showing some support.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor reducing beta: trim exposure to crowded tech names given narrow leadership and RISK-OFF backdrop; favor selective Energy/Healthcare ABOVE TREND names (XOM (1W: +5.39% | 1M: +6.44%) ABOVE TREND, TMO (1W: +6.44% | 1M: +9.11%) ABOVE TREND). Monitor RECOVERY names (PANW, ISRG, LLY) for confirmation before re-adding to core.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: META (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +13.63%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +5.39% | 1M: +6.44%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +5.73% | 1M: +14.44%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ORCL (1W: -13.64% | 1M: -6.76%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -5.90% | 1M: -5.66%) BELOW TREND, ETN (1W: -7.04% | 1M: -13.09%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +2.41% | 1M: +8.89%) — sector strength amid commodity tailwinds. BEARISH: Utilities (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -6.01%) and Industrials (1W: -2.17% | 1M: -7.88%) — watch for accelerating selling.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
META resistance: near recent highs after 1W surge (monitor for consolidation). NVDA support: watch for failure below short-term 1W lows as BELOW TREND continuation risk. XOM breakout: hold ABOVE TREND momentum on continued project approvals/news flow.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
ISRG (+75): What Is Intuitive Surgical Gaining From Its First CE Mark In Gynecology? — ISRG (1W: +7.71% | 1M: -4.40%) RECOVERY, sentiment confirming strong 1W move but 1M lag remains. XOM (+60): Carbon capture approval headline — XOM (1W: +5.39% | 1M: +6.44%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed. NOW (+50): AI Control Tower news — NOW (1W: +5.73% | 1M: +14.44%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
ORCL (-45): Backlog reality headline — ORCL (1W: -13.64% | 1M: -6.76%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed. TSLA (-45): regulator query headline — TSLA (1W: -3.15% | 1M: +4.18%) CORRECTION, sentiment aligns with short-term weakness; watch for further downside. WMT (-40): grocery competition headline — WMT (1W: +1.92% | 1M: -6.00%) RECOVERY, sentiment divergent from short 1W strength, monitor.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, style mixed / no clear leadership. XOM (1W: +5.39% | 1M: +6.44%) ABOVE TREND and META (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +13.63%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: narrow tech leadership and MAJOR divergence across several large-cap names (PANW, ISRG, GOOGL, LLY, WMT) — treat rallies as tactical until breadth improves.
